rationale: The current get_object method retrieves the Document object first and then checks permissions, which creates an Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) vulnerability. An attacker could manipulate the document_id parameter to access documents they shouldn't have access to. The fix moves the permission check to the queryset level by using the permission_policy to filter objects the user has access to before retrieval, ensuring that only authorized documents can be accessed.
patch:
--- /Users/justinexue/Downloads/wagtail/wagtail/documents/views/documents.py
+++ /Users/justinexue/Downloads/wagtail/wagtail/documents/views/documents.py
@@ -223,15 +223,13 @@ class EditView(generic.EditView):
 
 def get_object(self, queryset=None):
 obj_id = self.request.GET.get("document_id")
+ if queryset is None:
+ queryset = self.permission_policy.instances_user_has_any_permission_for(
+ self.request.user, [self.permission_required]
+ )
+ 
 if obj_id:
- obj = Document.objects.get(pk=obj_id)
+ obj = queryset.get(pk=obj_id)
 else:
 obj = super().get_object(queryset)
-
- if not self.permission_policy.user_has_permission_for_instance(
- self.request.user, self.permission_required, obj
- ):
- raise PermissionDenied
 return obj
